notes:
Top-line: enterprise support platform trying to replace brittle macros + manual KB lookup with RAG-driven agent assist. Primary asks: accurate citations, fresh content, multi-source retrieval (Zendesk -> Confluence -> PR changelogs), and reliable behavior during support spikes.

POC scope: ingest last 5 years of Zendesk tickets (threads + attachments), Confluence KB, release notes. Vector refresh cadence: customer prefers 4-6 hour refresh; must support partial reindexing for new articles.

Latency / throughput targets: p50 <= 200ms for retrieval+rank on agent-assist queries when served from Dedicated pool; willing to accept p95 <= 800ms for complex multi-source joins. Throughput target: sustained 80 qps for 500 agents, burst to 1200 qps during incidents. Cost sensitivity: medium — will trade some token cost for lower latency, but needs predictable unit economics for month-to-month budgeting.

Model preference: prefer a 2-tier routing strategy — strong LLM (open quantized model) for final answer + citation assembly, cheaper smaller model for candidate reranking and short summaries. Ask: ability to route by policy and automatic fallback to open smaller variants when Dedicated capacity saturated.

Tool-calling / writeback: need ticket write-back to Zendesk + internal tooling calls (escalation workflow trigger). Must support audit trails for all writebacks and function calls.

Security/Compliance notes: "We need SAML SSO, enterprise KMS, audit logs for all model calls, and 13-month retention controls. Data residency: EU customer subset must remain in eu-west-1; considering on-prem option for one regulated customer." — Head of Security.

Quotes from calls: "If answers don't include precise doc citations we can't trust them in QA workflow" — Support Ops lead.

Open technical questions: how vector DB handles incremental updates under load; exact fallback model latency numbers; compatibility with their internal kafka-based ingestion pipeline. SE has started a compatibility spike.

Stubs: drive pricing deck, security FAQ + SSO config doc in Drive (see links). Fireflies recorded demos mentioned above. Jira escalations raised for ingestion connector (INFRA-556).
